candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `balances[owner] = totalDistributed;` so NETM() no longer credits the owner's balance.
Replace the credited amount `totalDistributed` with `totalRemaining` when setting the owner's balance.
Replace the balance addition `balances[_to] + _amount` with a subtraction so recipients' balances decrease instead of increase.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check in the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can execute NETM() and receive the credited balance.
Remove the decrement of allowed[_from][msg.sender] so the allowance is never reduced by transferFrom.
Increase the allowance instead of decreasing it, so allowed grows by _amount on each transferFrom.
Zero out the spender's allowance after any transferFrom instead of decrementing it by the transferred amount.
